welcome:
Welcome {name}!
──────────────────

📨  With this bot you can send premium emojis
in any Telegram chat!

🔖  Use the menu below:
set_shared_ok: ✅ {added} emoji(s) from the shared set were added to your account.
set_shared_invalid: ⚠️ This set code is invalid or expired.
premium_intro:
✨  Send Premium Emoji
──────────────────

📝  Send a new message in this chat:

⚡  Multiple premium emojis (send them all at once)
or a numeric code: [5792080508976373427]

🎙  Separate multiple codes with spaces or brackets:
[code1] [code2] [code3]

🎙  Then you can choose a custom name
(or type "default")
extract_intro:
📤  Extract Premium Emoji Code
──────────────────

🅰  Send me one or more premium emojis:

🔷  Note: the emoji must be premium
(regular emojis have no code)

🎙  You can also send several at once
extract_pack_prompt:
🎁  Send the premium emoji pack link:
Example: https://t.me/addemoji/PackName
extract_pack_invalid: ⚠️ Not a valid emoji pack link. Try again or send the full addemoji/... link.
extract_pack_empty: ⚠️ The pack is empty or invalid.
extract_pack_partial_error: ❌ Error sending part of the results: {error}
my_emojis_empty: You haven't saved any emojis yet.
limit_reached: ⛔️ You've reached the limit of {limit} emojis. Contact support to increase it.
limit_reached_plain: ⛔️ You've reached the limit of {limit} emojis.
add_emoji_prompt: ✏️  Send the premium emoji you want (the emoji itself, or a code like [id]):
add_emoji_not_found: ⚠️ No valid premium emoji or code found. Try again.
add_emoji_ask_name: {alt}  Now send a custom name for this emoji (or type "default"):
channels_header:
⌘  My Channels
──────────────────

🎙  Posts containing an emoji code in active channels
are automatically converted to premium emojis.
add_channel_prompt:
✈️  Add Channel
──────────────────

📨  First, make the bot an admin in your channel with these permissions:

⚡ Add members (invite via link)
⚡ Add admins
⚡ Edit messages

🎙  The channel must have at least {min_members} members.

📨  Then send the channel's numeric ID or username:
e.g. @my_channel or -1001234567890
channel_invalid: ⚠️ This is not a valid channel.
channel_too_small: ⚠️ The channel must have at least {min_members} members (currently: {count}).
channel_no_admin: ⚠️ The bot must be an admin in this channel with "edit messages" permission.
channel_perm_check_failed: ❌ Couldn't check the bot's permissions in the channel: {error}
channel_added:
✅ Channel "{title}" registered successfully.
From now on, [id] codes in this channel's posts will auto-convert to emojis.
help_text:
❓  Bot Help
──────────────────

1️⃣ To send premium emojis in other chats, use inline mode:
@your_bot text [emoji_id]

2️⃣ To extract the IDs of all emojis in a pack, send the pack link to the bot.

3️⃣ In "My Emojis" you can save your frequently used emojis.

4️⃣ By adding a channel, posts containing codes are automatically converted.
support_text:
💎  Support
──────────────────

📨  To contact support, choose one of the options below:

⚡ Support Chat:
Send your message here, support will reply through the bot

🕐 Send a Ticket:
Submit your message for support to respond
support_chat_prompt: 📨 Write your message; it will be sent directly (only through the bot) to support:
support_msg_sent: ✅ Your message was sent to support. Please wait for a reply.
support_reply_fail: ❌ Not sent (user has blocked the bot).
ticket_prompt: 🖼 Write your ticket text to register it:
ticket_registered: ✅ Your ticket was registered. It will be reviewed soon.
admin_no_access: ⛔️ You don't have access to this section.
admin_unlimit_prompt: 🔓 Send the numeric ID of the user whose limit you want removed:
admin_unlimit_notify_user: 🎉 Your emoji storage limit was removed by an admin and is now unlimited.
admin_broadcast_prompt: 📢 Send the broadcast message text to send it to all users:
